methods.real_data_scope: Deterministic spike counts and unsmoothed exposure-normalized rates on native CASCADE DS01 AP timestamps and explicitly declared recorded-event subsets. Imposed gaps are not claimed as original acquisition dropouts. Multi-unit and numerical edge cases use separately labeled synthetic examples.
methods.oracle: Independent numpy.histogram with explicit final-edge exclusion; direct scalar interval overlaps. Exact integer counts and masks; exposure atol=1e-12 seconds, rtol=0.

methods.real_data_scope: Deterministic spike counts and unsmoothed exposure-normalized rates on native CASCADE DS01 AP timestamps and explicitly declared recorded-event subsets. Imposed gaps are not claimed as original acquisition dropouts. Multi-unit and numerical edge cases use separately labeled synthetic examples.
methods.oracle: Independently counted native events divided by explicit observation seconds; reconstructed counts conserved. Rates rtol=1e-12 and atol=1e-12 Hz; reconstructed counts atol=1e-12.

data_structure_scope.processing_algorithms: Spike binning and firing-rate normalization implemented in mazepy.neural; other algorithms planned
